with source_posts as (
    select
        cast(page_id as varchar) as page_id,
        page_name,
        cast(post_id as varchar) as post_id,
        coalesce(post_message, '') as post_message,
        created_timestamp,
        coalesce(shares, 0)::bigint as shares,
        coalesce(impressions, 0)::integer as impressions,
        coalesce(post_url, '') as post_url
    from staging.stg_social_media__facebook_posts
    where created_timestamp is not null
      and created_timestamp >= current_date - interval '2 years'
),
classified_posts as (
    select *,
        lower(post_message) as lower_message,
        case
            when contains(lower(post_message), 'http://') or contains(lower(post_message), 'https://') then 'link'
            when contains(lower(post_message), 'image') or contains(lower(post_message), 'photo') then 'photo'
            when contains(lower(post_message), 'video') then 'video'
            else 'text'
        end as content_type
    from source_posts
),
featured_posts as (
    select *,
        row_number() over (partition by page_id order by created_timestamp desc) as page_recency_rank,
        sum(shares) over (
            partition by page_id order by created_timestamp
            rows between 6 preceding and current row
        ) as rolling_7_post_shares
    from classified_posts
)
select
    page_id,
    page_name,
    post_id,
    post_message,
    created_timestamp,
    'facebook'::varchar as platform,
    0::bigint as clicks,
    impressions,
    0::bigint as likes,
    shares,
    0::bigint as comments,
    post_url,
    content_type,
    (contains(lower_message, 'http://') or contains(lower_message, 'https://')) as has_link,
    length(trim(post_message))::bigint as text_length_chars,
    case when trim(post_message) = '' then 0
         else length(trim(post_message)) - length(replace(trim(post_message), ' ', '')) + 1 end::bigint as text_word_count,
    cast(created_timestamp as date) as day,
    date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date as week,
    date_trunc('month', created_timestamp)::date as month,
    page_recency_rank,
    rolling_7_post_shares::bigint as rolling_7_post_shares,
    case when impressions > 0 then shares::double / impressions else 0.0 end as engagement_rate
from featured_posts

with source_posts as (
    select *
    from staging.stg_social_media__instagram_posts
    where page_id is not null
      and created_timestamp >= current_date - interval '2 years'
)
select
    cast(page_id as varchar) as page_id,
    page_name,
    cast(post_id as varchar) as post_id,
    coalesce(post_caption, '')::varchar as post_message,
    created_timestamp,
    'instagram'::varchar as platform,
    coalesce(engagement, 0)::bigint as clicks,
    coalesce(impressions, 0)::bigint as impressions,
    coalesce(likes, 0)::bigint as likes,
    coalesce(shares, 0)::bigint as shares,
    coalesce(comments, 0)::bigint as comments,
    coalesce(post_url, '')::varchar as post_url,
    coalesce(saves, 0)::bigint as saves,
    coalesce(reach, 0)::bigint as reach,
    coalesce(account_followers, 0)::bigint as account_followers,
    case media_type_category
        when 'Photo' then 'Feed Post'
        when 'Video' then 'Feed Post'
        when 'Carousel' then 'Feed Post'
        when 'Reel' then 'Reel'
        when 'Story' then 'Story'
        else media_type_category end::varchar as content_format,
    case when coalesce(impressions, 0) > 0 and engagement_rate is not null then engagement_rate::double
         when coalesce(impressions, 0) > 0 then coalesce(engagement, 0)::double / impressions
         else 0.0 end as calculated_engagement_rate,
    case when coalesce(account_followers, 0) > 0 then coalesce(engagement, 0)::double / account_followers else 0.0 end as followers_engagement_rate
from source_posts

      business_logic: '- Source: staging.stg_social_media__instagram_posts. - Filter rows where page_id is not null and created_timestamp is within the last 2 years from current date. - Metrics standardization: - Treat missing as 0: impressions, likes, comments, saves, shares, reach, engagement, account_followers. - calculated_engagement_rate: - If impressions > 0 and a source engagement_rate exists, use that value. - Else if impressions > 0, compute engagement divided by impressions (engagement treated as 0 when missing). - Else set to 0.0. - content_format mapping from media_type_category: - Photo, Video, Carousel -> "Feed Post"; Reel -> "Reel"; Story -> "Story"; otherwise use the original category (may be null). - Final shaping: - Cast page_id and post_id to VARCHAR. - post_message = post_caption with nulls replaced by empty string; post_url with nulls replaced by empty string. - platform = ''instagram''. - clicks = engagement with nulls treated as 0. - followers_engagement_rate = engagement divided by account_followers when followers > 0 (engagement treated as 0 when missing); otherwise 0.0. - Output one row per source post record; no additional aggregation or ordering.'

      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Instagram business account identifier; filtered to non-null and cast to VARCHAR
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account/page display name from the source; may be null
      - name: post_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Instagram media identifier; cast to VARCHAR
      - name: post_message
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Post caption text with NULL replaced by empty string; casing and whitespace are preserved
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Media creation timestamp; only posts from the last 2 years are included
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Literal platform label 'instagram'
      - name: clicks

    select *

        cast(video_id as varchar) as post_id,

        coalesce(subscribers, 0)::double as channel_subscribers,

    page_name,
    post_id,

with page_activity as (
    select 'facebook'::varchar as platform, page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date as activity_week
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
    union all
    select 'instagram', page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
    union all
    select 'linkedin', page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
    union all
    select 'twitter', page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
    union all
    select 'youtube', page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
),
active_page_weeks as (
    select distinct platform, activity_week, page_id
    from page_activity
    where page_id is not null
),
page_cohorts as (
    select platform, page_id, min(activity_week) as cohort_week
    from active_page_weeks
    group by platform, page_id
),
cohort_sizes as (
    select platform, cohort_week, count(distinct page_id)::bigint as cohort_pages
    from page_cohorts
    group by platform, cohort_week
),
cohort_spine as (
    select c.platform, c.cohort_week, offsets.week_offset::bigint as week_offset,
           (c.cohort_week + offsets.week_offset * interval '1 week')::timestamp as target_week,
           c.cohort_pages
    from cohort_sizes c,
         unnest(range(0, 13)) as offsets(week_offset)
),
weekly_activity as (
    select platform, activity_week, count(distinct page_id)::bigint as retained_pages
    from active_page_weeks
    group by platform, activity_week
)
select
    s.platform,
    s.cohort_week,
    s.week_offset,
    s.target_week,
    s.cohort_pages,
    coalesce(a.retained_pages, 0)::bigint as retained_pages,
    case when s.cohort_pages > 0 then coalesce(a.retained_pages, 0)::double / s.cohort_pages else 0.0 end as retention_rate
from cohort_spine s
left join weekly_activity a
    on a.platform = s.platform and a.activity_week = cast(s.target_week as date)

    select 'facebook'::varchar as platform, page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date as activity_week
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
    union all
    select 'instagram', page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
    union all
    select 'linkedin', page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
    union all
    select 'twitter', page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
    union all
    select 'youtube', page_id, date_trunc('week', created_timestamp)::date
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting where created_timestamp is not null
),
active_page_weeks as (
    select distinct platform, activity_week, page_id
    from page_activity
    where page_id is not null
),
page_cohorts as (
    select platform, page_id, min(activity_week) as cohort_week
    from active_page_weeks
    group by platform, page_id
),
cohort_sizes as (
    select platform, cohort_week, count(distinct page_id)::bigint as cohort_pages
    from page_cohorts
    group by platform, cohort_week
),
cohort_spine as (
    select c.platform, c.cohort_week, offsets.week_offset::bigint as week_offset,
           (c.cohort_week + offsets.week_offset * interval '1 week')::timestamp as target_week,
           c.cohort_pages
    from cohort_sizes c,
         unnest(range(0, 13)) as offsets(week_offset)
),
weekly_activity as (
    select platform, activity_week, count(distinct page_id)::bigint as retained_pages
    from active_page_weeks
    group by platform, activity_week
)
select
    s.platform,
    s.cohort_week,
    s.week_offset,
    s.target_week,
    s.cohort_pages,
    coalesce(a.retained_pages, 0)::bigint as retained_pages,
    case when s.cohort_pages > 0 then coalesce(a.retained_pages, 0)::double / s.cohort_pages else 0.0 end as retention_rate
from cohort_spine s
left join weekly_activity a
    on a.platform = s.platform and a.activity_week = cast(s.target_week as date)

- name: social_media_reporting__retention_kpis
      description: Weekly retention KPIs by platform using posting-activity cohorts over a fixed 13-week window
      grain: One row per platform per cohort_week per week_offset
      source_models:
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - Union page activity from the five source models; only keep rows where created_timestamp is present. - Assign platform as one of: "facebook", "instagram", "linkedin", "twitter", "youtube". - Weekly normalization: - Bucket activity into ISO weeks starting Monday 00:00. - A page is considered active in a week if it posts at least once; multiple posts in the same week do not increase the activity count. - Cohorts: - For each (page_id, platform), set cohort_week to the earliest week with activity. - For each (platform, cohort_week), cohort_pages is the number of unique pages in that cohort. - Observation spine: - Generate week_offset values from 0 to 12 inclusive. - For each cohort, create 13 rows and set target_week to the start of the week that is week_offset weeks after cohort_week; when week_offset = 0, target_week equals cohort_week. - Activity presence: - Build distinct (platform, week, page_id) combinations so each active page-week is counted once. - Retention: - For each spine row, retained_pages is the number of unique pages active on the platform in target_week; this is not limited to members of the cohort. - KPI: - retention_rate = retained_pages divided by cohort_pages when cohort_pages > 0; otherwise 0.0. - No rounding; stored as double precision; values may exceed 1.0 due to the numerator scope. - Output: - Emit platform, cohort_week, week_offset, target_week, cohort_pages, retained_pages, retention_rate. - No explicit ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Platform name in lowercase: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, or youtube'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: cohort_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start date (Monday) of the first week the page is active for the platform
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: week_offset
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of weeks since cohort_week, inclusive 0 to 12
        tests:
        - not_null
        - week_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 12
      - name: target_week
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Start-of-week timestamp at week_offset weeks after cohort_week; equals cohort_week when offset is 0
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: cohort_pages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique pages in the cohort for each (platform, cohort_week)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: retained_pages
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique pages active on the platform in target_week; one count per page-week; not limited to cohort members
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of retained_pages to cohort_pages; if cohort_pages is 0 then 0.0; no rounding; may exceed 1.0
        tests:
        - not_null
        - retention_rate >= 0

with all_posts as (
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
    union all
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting
    union all
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting
    union all
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
    union all
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
),
recent_posts as (
    select
        page_id, page_name, post_id, coalesce(post_message, '')::varchar as post_message,
        created_timestamp, platform,
        coalesce(clicks, 0)::hugeint as clicks,
        coalesce(impressions, 0)::hugeint as impressions,
        coalesce(likes, 0)::hugeint as likes,
        coalesce(shares, 0)::hugeint as shares,
        coalesce(comments, 0)::hugeint as comments,
        coalesce(post_url, '')::varchar as post_url
    from all_posts
    where created_timestamp is not null
      and ((platform = 'linkedin' and created_timestamp >= current_date - interval '4 years')
        or (platform <> 'linkedin' and created_timestamp >= current_date - interval '2 years'))
),
scored_posts as (
    select *,
        case when impressions > 0 then (clicks + likes + shares + comments)::double / impressions else 0.0 end as engagement_rate,
        case platform
            when 'facebook' then case when impressions > 0 then 75 else 50 end
            when 'instagram' then case when impressions > 0 then 90 else 50 end
            when 'twitter' then case when impressions > 0 then 80 else 50 end
            when 'youtube' then case when clicks > 0 then 95 else 50 end
            when 'linkedin' then case when impressions > 0 then 70 else 50 end
            else 50 end::integer as content_quality_score
    from recent_posts
),
ranked_posts as (
    select *,
        row_number() over (partition by platform, cast(created_timestamp as date) order by impressions desc) as daily_platform_rank,
        row_number() over (partition by platform order by impressions desc) as platform_lifetime_rank
    from scored_posts
)
select
    page_id, page_name, post_id, created_timestamp, platform, post_message, post_url,
    clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, engagement_rate, content_quality_score,
    daily_platform_rank, platform_lifetime_rank
from ranked_posts
order by created_timestamp desc, engagement_rate desc

cte_definitions.sql: SELECT page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform, clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url FROM intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting UNION ALL SELECT page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform, clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url FROM intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting UNION ALL SELECT page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform, clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url FROM intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting UNION ALL SELECT page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform, clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url FROM intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting UNION ALL SELECT page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform, clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url FROM intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting

cte_definitions.name: recent_posts
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT page_id, page_name, post_id, CAST(COALESCE(post_message, '') AS TEXT) AS post_message, created_timestamp, platform, CAST(COALESCE(clicks, 0) AS INT128) AS clicks, CAST(COALESCE(impressions, 0) AS INT128) AS impressions, CAST(COALESCE(likes, 0) AS INT128) AS likes, CAST(COALESCE(shares, 0) AS INT128) AS shares, CAST(COALESCE(comments, 0) AS INT128) AS comments, CAST(COALESCE(post_url, '') AS TEXT) AS post_url FROM all_posts WHERE NOT created_timestamp IS NULL AND ((platform = 'linkedin' AND created_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '4' YEARS) OR (platform <> 'linkedin' AND created_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2' YEARS))

cte_definitions.name: scored_posts
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN CAST((clicks + likes + shares + comments) AS DOUBLE) / impressions ELSE 0.0 END AS engagement_rate, CAST(CASE platform WHEN 'facebook' THEN CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN 75 ELSE 50 END WHEN 'instagram' THEN CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN 90 ELSE 50 END WHEN 'twitter' THEN CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN 80 ELSE 50 END WHEN 'youtube' THEN CASE WHEN clicks > 0 THEN 95 ELSE 50 END WHEN 'linkedin' THEN CASE WHEN impressions > 0 THEN 70 ELSE 50 END ELSE 50 END AS INT) AS content_quality_score FROM recent_posts

cte_definitions.name: ranked_posts
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY platform, CAST(created_timestamp AS DATE) ORDER BY impressions DESC) AS daily_platform_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY platform ORDER BY impressions DESC) AS platform_lifetime_rank FROM scored_posts

- name: social_media_reporting__rollup_report
      description: Unified cross-platform post/video rollup with standardized metrics, platform-specific quality score, rankings, and recent-window filtering
      grain: One row per platform + page_id + post_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
      - intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
      business_logic: '- Union all five platform models with a platform label: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, youtube; select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url. For YouTube, the upstream shares value maps to the unified shares position. - Filter out rows with NULL created_timestamp. - Apply recent data windows relative to the current date: - LinkedIn: keep the last 4 years. - All other platforms: keep the last 2 years. - Standardize content fields: - post_message: default NULL to empty string "". - post_url: default NULL to empty string "". - Standardize metric fields (clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments): default NULL to 0; no aggregation or deduplication is performed. - Compute engagement_rate: - If impressions > 0: (clicks + likes + shares + comments) / impressions. - Otherwise: 0.0. - No rounding or capping; always non-null and may exceed 1.0. - Compute content_quality_score by platform: - facebook: 75 if impressions > 0, else 50. - instagram: 90 if impressions > 0, else 50. - twitter: 80 if impressions > 0, else 50. - youtube: 95 if clicks > 0, else 50. - linkedin: 70 if impressions > 0, else 50. - Rankings (computed after the above filtering): - daily_platform_rank: within each platform and calendar day of created_timestamp, assign a 1-based rank by sorting impressions descending; ties get arbitrary order. - platform_lifetime_rank: within each platform across the filtered dataset, assign a 1-based rank by sorting impressions descending; ties get arbitrary order. - Final result ordering for display: created_timestamp descending, then engagement_rate descending.'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source page/account identifier within a platform
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source page/account display name; may be null
      - name: post_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source post/media identifier within platform and page
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: created_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Post/media publish timestamp; rows with NULL are excluded
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Platform label: facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, youtube'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: post_message
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Post/media text; NULL defaults to empty string; casing and whitespace preserved
      - name: post_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Canonical post/media URL; NULL defaults to empty string; casing and whitespace preserved
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total clicks; NULL defaults to 0; used in engagement_rate and YouTube quality rule
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total impressions; NULL defaults to 0; denominator for engagement_rate and several quality rules
      - name: likes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total likes; NULL defaults to 0; included in engagement_rate numerator
      - name: shares
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total shares; NULL defaults to 0; included in engagement_rate numerator; for YouTube, upstream shares are used
      - name: comments
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total comments; NULL defaults to 0; included in engagement_rate numerator
      - name: engagement_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If impressions > 0, (clicks + likes + shares + comments) / impressions; else 0.0; not rounded or capped; never null
      - name: content_quality_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Platform rule-based score: FB 75 if impressions > 0; IG 90 if impressions > 0; TW 80 if impressions > 0; YT 95 if clicks > 0; LI 70 if impressions > 0; otherwise 50'
      - name: daily_platform_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 1-based rank within each platform and calendar day by impressions descending; ties receive arbitrary order
      - name: platform_lifetime_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 1-based rank within each platform across the filtered dataset by impressions descending; ties receive arbitrary order
